scope: Three independent AB/BA/AB matched engine pairs, identical CLI and verified-stream implementation and official gzip Rust image; only the engine Unix socket readiness helper changes. Ordinary CLI-managed engine provisioning stays inside the first-command timer; per-run warm repeats summarized first.
limits: Same frozen inventory/readiness CLI; engine images differ only by the Unix readiness helper and its tests
No performance threshold or required startup delay; retain all cold/warm gains and losses
First check and external upgrade profiled; other timed scenarios omit --profile but export local OTLP
Native uses docker exec in matched preinstalled image, not bare host
Engine/CLI/native image and local module preinstalled; no full-install claim
CLI provisions its own engine; first-check already includes provisioning, so the two first-use fields are identical, not additive
Post-first-CLI diagnostic helper copied into owned engine for local-only debug retrieval; no package installation or image prewarming
Old-engine GC disabled to preserve unrelated user/build engines; owned groups cleaned explicitly after measurement
Default engine registry route, no diagnostic config or local registry
Host page/CDN caches not purged; native follows Dagger for initial check
Cargo diagnostic sessions occur after measured checks on both treatments
The later application diagnostic follows failure/revisit/cached-repair and rebuilds three crates; ordinary timed application edits rebuild only ripgrep
Three within-run samples are repeated observations, not nine independent pairs
